GCR runtime packages
====================

The extension bundles @gcr/client-contract 0.1.0-alpha.48 and
@gcr/client-core 0.1.0-alpha.49 and @gcr/client-executors 0.1.0-alpha.50
under Apache-2.0.
Original notices and license texts are retained in their package directories.
Immutable source and artifact provenance is recorded in
vendor/gcr/0.1.0-alpha.50/ in the source repository.
